personalInfo.name: Sam Altman
personalInfo.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years building reliable, high-scale backend and full-stack systems. Specializes in distributed services, developer platforms, and turning ambiguous product goals into shipped, well-tested software. Comfortable leading projects end to end and mentoring engineers.

experiences.description:
• Led design of a payments orchestration service handling 40k+ requests/sec, cutting p99 latency by 38%.
  • Drove migration of a monolith module to event-driven microservices, reducing deploy times from 45m to 6m.
  • Mentored 4 engineers and established the team's testing and code-review standards.

• Built a GraphQL pricing API used by 12M+ daily users, improving cache hit rate to 94%.
  • Shipped an experimentation framework adopted by 20+ teams, accelerating A/B test setup by 70%.

• Developed merchant analytics dashboards in React/Node, serving 500k+ stores.
  • Reduced background job failures by 60% by redesigning the retry and queue strategy.
